responsibility: Implements predictive commoning, a loop optimization that reuses values from earlier iterations—primarily memory-reference results—through SSA temporaries and optional unrolling. It groups loop data references by dependence components, builds reuse chains rooted at loads/stores, combines compatible chains, inserts initializer/finalizer code and PHIs, may unroll loops to eliminate latch copies, and updates SSA/loop state so repeated memory accesses can be replaced by carried scalar values.
